# Actual shared-gradient inspection: first attempts

Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The [bounded work packet](../gradient-binding-packet.md) fixes the contract before
implementation. This is informed development, not a controlled authoring benchmark.

- [Initial pure inspector](Gradient-first.lean.txt) precedes checking.
  [Initial recheck](initial-recheck.json), [projection repair](project-repair.log)
  and [routing check](inspection-routing-check.log) preserve actual diagnostics.
  Repairs normalize Option binds before dependent pattern cases, extract
  array arity explicitly, and prove positional inverse routing for all widths.
- [Initial complex proof](HierarchicalGradient-first.lean.txt) and
  [first check](math-first-check.log) preserve failures concerning function
  extensionality, dependent Fin coordinates and an unavailable simp constant.
  The completed proof also aligns actual evaluation fuel, accounts for the
  sequence's initial identity, and handles the unique empty basis explicitly.
- [Initial native fixture](test_hierarchical_gradient-first.py.txt) precedes
  compilation; [the first run](../gradient-binding-native-first.json) failed
  because a generated multiline Lean record field was misaligned. The record
  formatting was repaired without changing the acceptance expectations.

[Current native results](../gradient-binding-native.json) contain 175 outcomes
and 574 independent numerical phase vectors. The canonical sources are
[Gradient](../../../../lean-kernel/QleisliKernel/Hierarchical/Gradient.lean),
[HierarchicalGradient](../../../../lean/Qleisli/HierarchicalGradient.lean) and
[the native oracle](../../../../scripts/test_hierarchical_gradient.py).
The inspector proves a component diagonal, with no enabled external schema.
Whole-artifact typing, full QFT/H/Fourier binding and the source/corpus gates
remain distinct obligations.

The [first compiled audit](../gradient-binding-registry-first.json) rejected
`inspectAux._unsafe_rec`, a partial helper generated by Lean's surface recursive
definition. [Explicit structural annotation](../gradient-binding-registry-structural.json)
still generated the same helper. The implementation now uses `Nat.rec` directly;
its equation lemmas are proved by reflexivity, and all binding/semantic theorems
remain about this executable definition. A [proof-reduction repair](../gradient-binding-registry-recursion.json)
records the necessary equation simplifications. No policy exception or compiler
implementation override was introduced.
